description: Post-process stack asset mutation — add/remove passes by class name

AddPass.description: Add a post-process pass of the given class to a PA_PostProcessStack asset. At most one pass per class per stack. Creates the pass object on the asset and appends it to the stack list.

passClass.description: Reflected PostProcessPass subclass name (e.g. TonemapPass, BloomPass)

RemovePass.description: Remove the post-process pass of the given class from a PA_PostProcessStack asset. Deletes the pass object from the asset and removes it from the stack list.

passClass.description: Reflected PostProcessPass subclass name to remove
